none: PAS CAM-E12207: Roman Coin : Nummus of the House of Theodosius
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Theodosius. Mint is uncertain, 388-402, Reece period 21. Obverse is illegible. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding trophy and dragging captive; to left barred-rho. Reverse legend reads [SALVS REI PVBLICAE]. Condition is fine, die axis is uncertain, weight is 1.03g, diameter is 11.64mm
